hesitations: facility_type (Initial Term Loans): the agreement never uses 'Term A'/'Term B' or 'delayed draw'. Classified by amortization per the unlettered-tranche rule: 0.625%/qtr (2.5%/yr) through year 1, 1.25%/qtr (5%/yr) years 2-3, 1.875%/qtr (7.5%/yr) thereafter -> term_loan_a. HOWEVER the commitment is made on the Closing Date (2024-08-13) and funded in a single draw on the Acquisition Closing Date (Alimera; funded 2024-09-16), with a ticking fee on the unused Initial Term Loan Commitments from two months after Closing and automatic termination on the Acquisition Outside Date (5th Business Day after 2024-12-21). The borrower's own 8-K and 10-Q describe it as a 'delayed-draw term loan facility (the Term Loan A)'. schema.md has no rule stating when delayed_draw_term_loan applies versus term_loan_a; this document forces one. Proposed rule: delayed_draw_term_loan only where the agreement itself labels the tranche delayed-draw or provides a multi-draw availability period; a single-draw acquisition term loan committed at signing and funded on the acquisition closing date is classified by amortization. If the rule goes the other way, this record's value becomes delayed_draw_term_loan.

facility_name: labeling-guide step 2 says to use the names quoted in the commitment section, which are 'Revolving Loans' (2.1(a)) and 'Initial Term Loan' / 'Initial Term Loan Facility' (2.2(a)(i)). Defensible alternatives are the Article I facility-level defined term 'Revolving Facility' (also used in the recitals) and 'Initial Term Loan Facility'. Weak-signal field; recorded the section-heading form for both tranches.

aggregate_commitment (revolver): the 'Revolving Commitment' definition points only to Schedule 2.1(a), which is omitted from the exhibit (8-K footnote: schedules omitted under Item 601(a)(5)). The $75.0 million figure appears only in the recitals; there is no Article I defined term stating the aggregate. Recital governs by necessity.

maturity_date: no hard calendar date anywhere in the document; both facilities are defined as five years following the Closing Date, and 'Closing Date' is defined as 'the date of this Agreement' (2024-08-13), which would compute to 2029-08-13. Recorded as basis=relative per the rule that stated requires a hard date in the document.
notes.springing_maturity_proviso: Both the Revolving Maturity Date and the Term Maturity Date spring to the date that is 91 days prior to the final maturity of the Convertible Notes (2.25% Convertible Senior Notes due 2029-09-01, i.e. 2029-06-02) if any Convertible Notes remain outstanding on that date, unless (i) Unrestricted Cash >= outstanding Convertible Notes principal or (ii) 30-day average Daily VWAP >= 120% of the Conversion Price. Excluded from maturity_date per schema; noted here.
notes.covenant_holiday: 5.9(a): upon a Material Acquisition the Lead Borrower may elect to increase the maximum First Lien Net Leverage Ratio to 3.50:1.00 for four consecutive fiscal quarters. Conditional override; non-holiday level 3.00 recorded.
notes.first_test_date: Both covenants commence with the fiscal quarter ending on or about December 31, 2024.
notes.equity_cure: 5.9(c) Specified Equity Contribution cure right (max 2 of any 4 consecutive quarters). Not a field.
notes.margin_grid_detail: Four-level grid keyed to First Lien Net Leverage Ratio: Level I (>2.00x) 3.00% / Level II (<=2.00x, >1.25x) 2.75% / Level III (<=1.25x, >0.50x) 2.50% / Level IV (<=0.50x) 2.25% for Term Benchmark and RFR Loans; ABR margins are 100 bps lower (2.00/1.75/1.50/1.25). Opening level stated explicitly as 2.75% (Level II). One Applicable Margin definition applies to both facilities. Level I applies as a penalty pricing level when financials are late. The same table carries a commitment fee grid (0.40/0.35/0.30/0.25%), which does not bear on has_margin_grid.
notes.benchmark_detail: Adjusted Term SOFR Rate = Term SOFR Rate + 0.10% CSA, subject to the Floor; Term SOFR Rate resolves to the Term SOFR Reference Rate published by the CME Term SOFR Administrator. RFR Loans (Adjusted Daily Simple SOFR) may be requested only after a Benchmark Transition Event with respect to Term SOFR (2.1(a), 2.2(a)(i)) - fallback, not primary. ABR loans are the customary alternative and are not the answer.
notes.excluded_records: Letter of Credit Subfacility (2.3; $10,000,000 L/C commitment) and Swingline Loan Subfacility (2.4; $10,000,000) are sublimits of the Revolving Commitments. Incremental Facilities (2.22; Revolving Facility Increases and Incremental Term Facilities) are an option, not a commitment. Refinancing Amendments / Extended tranches (2.23) are contingent. None recorded.
notes.base_rate_margin_not_recorded: Opening ABR margin 1.75% (175 bps) - mechanically benchmark margin minus 100 bps; deliberately not a field.
notes.lender_count: Syndicated: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as Administrative Agent; Regions, Huntington, Bank of America as Joint Lead Arrangers/Syndication Agents; Wells Fargo, U.S. Bank, Capital One, PNC, Fifth Third as Documentation Agents; City National Bank also a signing Lender. Satisfies the >=3 lenders frame.
